subject: Pilot kickoff: scope, success metrics, owners & access (Lumiz Systems)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@lumiz.ai>, Alejandro Gomez <alejandro.gomez@lumiz.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot kickoff: scope, success metrics, owners & access (Lumiz Systems)

Hi Marta / Alejandro —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so your team can confirm we captured the priorities before we lock the pilot charter: 

- Primary pain: high inference cost and inconsistent latency for real-time recommendations (95th percentile spikes to ~1.2s under load).
- Goal for pilot: reduce 95th percentile latency to <600ms for the recommendation endpoint while cutting per-token cost by ~30% relative to your existing managed endpoints.
- Success metrics (proposal): 95th latency <600ms, average cost/token decrease >=30%, 99% availability during test windows, and no material drop in MRR affecting quality >2% (we will use the supplied eval set).
- Scope: 4-week evaluation using a subset of recommendation traffic (~5k daily requests), model variant selection (open model + quantized variants), and prompt/eval suite run against 1K labeled cases you provided.
- Owners: Lumiz infra — Alejandro (primary); Lumiz ML — Marta (primary). Redwood owners: me (AM), Karthik (runtime lead), and Connor (integration).
- Access needed: API key for a non-prod account, short-lived IAM role or service principal for s3 bucket access (only read for prompts/evals), and sample logs for latency baseline. See attached access-checklist.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll share a draft pilot charter (attached) and a sample prompt set for your review.
2) You confirm owners and provide the non-prod credentials and the eval dataset by EOD Monday (Dec 7).
3) We schedule a 30-min kickoff next Tuesday to finalize run windows and egress rules.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-charter-lumiz-draft.pdf (draft charter), access-checklist-lumiz.xlsx, sample-prompt-set-v1.txt

Happy to adjust anything — call out gaps and I’ll update.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Marta Ruiz <marta@lumiz.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: scope, success metrics, owners & access (Lumiz Systems)

Neha —

Thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few points from our side: 
- Owners: confirmed — I’ll be primary for ML/quality and Alejandro will handle infra/access. I’ll also loop in our Security (Laura) once we have the final access pattern.
- Timeline: the proposed 4-week window works, but we need the kickoff scheduled no later than Dec 8 to keep the calendar tight for a Jan demo to the product team.
- Eval set: I can deliver the 1k labeled cases by Monday morning; Alejandro will provision a non-prod bucket and send a short-lived service principal.

One ask: can Redwood run an initial smoke run on a 200-case sample within 48 hours of access so we can validate the prompt outputs before the full run?

Also, please send any compliance/contract pointers we should prep for (SOC2 evidence checklist) — we’ll need to start that conversation early.

—Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of ML, Lumiz Systems

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@lumiz.ai>, Alejandro Gomez <alejandro.gomez@lumiz.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: scope, success metrics, owners & access (Lumiz Systems)

Marta — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and for confirming owners. A few clarifications and commitments from our side: 

- Smoke run: yes — we’ll run a 200-case smoke test within 48 hours of receiving access. That will validate prompt behavior and basic latency expectations.
- Compliance: attaching a short SOC2 evidence checklist and our standard non-disclosure summary (not a full contract) to help your legal/security team triage early. We’ll route full procurement/PTA items through your contacts once the pilot scope is agreed.
- Pilot charter updates: I’ve added the smoke-run milestone and tightened the run windows to two 3-hour test windows per day (low-traffic periods you indicated). Charter attached (redwood-pilot-charter-lumiz-draft.pdf).

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in and a short agenda.

Open items for Alejandro: 
- Provide non-prod IAM principal or temporary credentials for bucket access (read-only)
- Share sample logs (gzipped) and the service account you want us to use for API calls

If any of you prefer a different kickoff time, call it out and I’ll adjust.

Thanks — Neha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta@lumiz.ai>, Alejandro Gomez <alejandro.gomez@lumiz.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff: scope, success metrics, owners & access (Lumiz Systems)

Looping in brief infra notes so we have a clear handoff for setup: 

- We’ll create a pilot project under the "redwood-pilot-lumiz" org. Connor will provision API credentials scoped to only the non-prod bucket you supply.
- Access pattern: prefer short-lived STS role assuming via OIDC connection. If Lumiz cannot do OIDC, we can accept a scoped service principal key rotated every 24 hours.
- Network: no inbound firewall changes required for outbound API calls; if Lumiz wants to whitelist Redwood IPs for egress, share the list and we’ll confirm.
- Observability: we’ll enable per-request tracing and share a read-only dashboard. We need sample logs (5–10 MB gzipped) for baseline latency profiling.

Connor — I’ll hand the runbook and the small infra checklist to you. Neha — once Alejandro supplies the credentials, flag me and I’ll start the project provisioning.

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Runtime
redwoodinference.com
